# 🚀 Release Checklist

- [ ] Version and changelog updated.
- [ ] Cargo.lock committed and reviewed.
- [ ] Formatting, Clippy, tests, and release build pass.
- [ ] Gzip compatibility verified.
- [ ] CLI behavior and overwrite semantics documented.
- [ ] Security limitations reviewed.
- [ ] Release artifact tested on target platforms.
- [ ] No generated target/ or private data committed.
